value.description: A half-buried brewing cask used to crystallize dreg from distilled corpse-bile. The production of dreg requires high ambient temperatures in order to properly distill the corpse within.\n\nThis method of obtaining shiver chemicals is usually used by gnoblins on pre-industrial worlds, or desperate shiver-addicts without access to chemfuel. Its macabre catalyst means most steal pets, rob morgues, or murder others just to obtain the corpses needed to produce the drug.

Small clay urns packed with powderized shiver, and a small wick to ignite and aerosolize the chemical agent. Upon shattered, they break open, releasing a cloud of tox gas into the immediate area.\n\nTox gas burns the lungs and eyes, causing a temporary shortness of breath and reduction in sight. Continued exposure to tox gas results in toxic buildup which can be lethal.

A cocktail of toxic chemical derivatives made from corpse-bile that had been vaporized, crystallized, and then crushed into shivers. Dreg neuters the mind completely; it's commonly used out of desperation, or sold as "lowgrade" to shiver-addicts in withdrawal - the method used to cook dreg means it's usually associated with the morally corrupt and utterly destitute.\n\nDreg is incredibly crude, and especially dangerous when mixed with other drugs as it often leads to heavy overdosing.

A volatile and noxious blend of industrial chemicals boiled down into a solid glass-like sheet and then crushed into small shards. Shiver neuters the minds of those suffering in urbworld back alleys, rimworld shard-dens, and the bellowing depths of forgeworlds - thus it's usually associated with squalor and destitution.

The recipe is never consistent across planets, as most cook it from whatever chemical byproducts they can get their hands on.

Mixed consumption of other drugs with shard can lead to overdosing.
A built-up tolerance to shiver. The more severe this tolerance is, the more shard it takes to numb the mind.

A chemical addiction to shiver. Long-term presence of shiver has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of shiver, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
Chickenbear feathers can be gathered and processed into a fine powder, which produces a mild euphoric sensation when burned and inhaled. Downpowder use can produce a dependency.
Downpowder's active chemical in the bloodstream. Generates a soft feeling of fuzzy well-being.
Because of a developed downpowder dependence, this person needs to regularly consume the drug to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
A built-up tolerance to downpowder. The more severe this tolerance is, the more downpowder it takes to get the same effect.

A chemical addiction to downpowder. Long-term use of downpowder has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of downpowder, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
